_comment: Word cloud generation config (Phase W3). select_by is one of input|name|id|all. For 'name', select is a list of case-insensitive substrings matched against transcript file names. For 'id', select is a list of 11-char YouTube ids (the [<id>] in the file name). For 'all', select is ignored and every transcript in transcripts/ + generated_transcripts/ is processed (captions preferred per video). For 'input', only the single INPUT file/id is processed. min_length/max_words/lowercase/language/stopwords_extra tune the tokenizer. language picks the built-in stopword list (en|fr|ro). Outputs go to data/wordclouds/*.word_cloud.json (skip-if-exists).
